bazarr.section.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Section heading on the Settings root above the Bazarr row.

bazarr.title.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Row label on the Settings root and page title. Bazarr is a product name; keep it.

bazarr.root_detail.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Detail line under the Bazarr row on the Settings root. One short sentence.

bazarr.copy.value: Bazarr finds subtitles from many providers. Add its address and API key and the player's “Wrong subtitles?” can use it.
bazarr.copy.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Narrative copy beside the Bazarr page. Two short sentences. Bazarr is a product name.

bazarr.address.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Row label: where Bazarr runs (its web address).

bazarr.address_detail.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Line under the Address row: how the address starts. Keep https:// and http:// as they are.

bazarr.key.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Row label: Bazarr's API key.

bazarr.key_detail.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Line under the API key row: where to find the key in Bazarr's own menus.

bazarr.test.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Action row: ask Bazarr whether the address and key work.

bazarr.forget.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Action row: remove the stored address and key.

bazarr.forget_detail.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Line under the Forget row.

bazarr.forget_sure.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Value of the Forget row after the first OK: asks for a second one.

bazarr.not_set.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Value of the Address or API key row before one is typed.

bazarr.summary_unset.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Value of the Bazarr row on the Settings root when no address and key are set.

bazarr.status_unset.value: Not set up. Add the address and API key, then test. The key stays on this TV, sealed like the Plex sign-in.
bazarr.status_unset.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line: Bazarr is not set up yet.

bazarr.status_untested.value: Not tested yet. Choose Test connection to check the address and key.
bazarr.status_untested.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line: address and key are set but not tried yet.

bazarr.status_testing.value: Checking… Asking Bazarr for its version.
bazarr.status_testing.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line while Bazarr is being asked.

bazarr.status_connected.value: Connected · Bazarr {version}. “Wrong subtitles?” in the player now offers Bazarr.
bazarr.status_connected.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line when Bazarr answered. {version} is Bazarr's version number.

bazarr.status_linked.value: Connected · Bazarr {version}. Sonarr {sonarr} and Radarr {radarr} are linked. “Wrong subtitles?” in the player now offers Bazarr.
bazarr.status_linked.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line when Bazarr answered and reports Sonarr and Radarr. The three are version numbers.

bazarr.status_unreachable.value: Can't reach Bazarr. No answer from that address. Check it and that this TV is on the same network.
bazarr.status_unreachable.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line when nothing answered at the address.

bazarr.status_bad_key.value: Bazarr refused the key. The address answers, but the API key is wrong. Copy it again from Bazarr.
bazarr.status_bad_key.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line when Bazarr answered that the API key is wrong.

bazarr.status_not_bazarr.value: That is not Bazarr. The address answers, but not like Bazarr. Check the address.
bazarr.status_not_bazarr.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line when the address answers, but not like Bazarr.

bazarr.problem_scheme.value: The address must start with https:// or http://.
bazarr.problem_scheme.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line when the typed address does not start with http:// or https://.

bazarr.problem_host.value: That is not a valid address.
bazarr.problem_host.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line when the typed address is not a valid web address.

bazarr.problem_plaintext.value: Plain http:// is only for addresses on your home network. Use https:// for any other.
bazarr.problem_plaintext.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line when a plain http:// address points outside the home network.

bazarr.problem_key.value: That is not a valid API key.
bazarr.problem_key.description: Settings > Integrations > Bazarr page. Status line when the typed API key cannot be used.
